cards.name: Domain of the Dark Ruler
cards.desc:
If you control no monsters, you can activate this card the turn it was Set. When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card and you have a Level 7 or higher DARK monster with 2500 DEF in your field or GY: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card, then if this card was activated during your turn, you can apply this effect.
● Neither player can activate Spell/Trap Cards for the rest of this turn.
You can only activate 1 "Domain of the Dark Ruler" per turn.

cards.name: Cyber Thuban
cards.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Cyber" Spell/Trap from your GY. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Machine "Cyber" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Cyber Thuban". If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect; your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when you Special Summon a Level 10 LIGHT Machine monster(s) this turn. You can only use each effect of "Cyber Thuban" once per turn.

cards.name: Cyber Alsafi
cards.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) if you control a Machine "Cyber" monster. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Born from Draconis" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished: You can activate this effect; until the end of your turn, the next battle damage your Level 10 LIGHT Machine monster inflicts to your opponent is doubled. You can only use each effect of "Cyber Alsafi" once per turn.

cards.name: White Prosperity
cards.desc: Special Summon up to 2 Level 4 or lower WATER monsters from your hand, then if you control 2 or more monsters with the same name, you can treat 1 of them as a Tuner. If a WATER monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY while this card is in your GY, and you have another monster in your field or GY with the same name as 1 of them: You can banish this card from your GY; draw 2 cards. You can only use each effect of "White Prosperity" once per turn.

cards.name: Rogue, the Dagger of Endymion
cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 card that mentions "Spell Counter" in its effect text or 1 "Endymion" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Rogue, the Dagger of Endymion". During the Main Phase, if you have "Regulus, the Prince of Endymion" in your field or GY (Quick Effect): You can target 1 card your opponent controls; give control of this card to your opponent, and if you do, destroy that card. You can only use each effect of "Rogue, the Dagger of Endymion" once per turn.
